note: Block materials (tilesets) a sculpture may use. A sculpture block stores the numeric material id; the role names here are how generators ask for one. Ids 1-9 for full blocks come from a real 2016-2018 Reign of Kings plugin (LevelSystem.cs, GetCubePlaceLevel, in github.com/RustServers-IO/oxideplugins @ 4de21d4) and are UNVERIFIED on our server: run /sculpt materials in game, which writes the real table to oxide/data/RealmSculptorMaterials.json, and fix any id here and in the plugin's MaterialRoles config. previewColour is a guess at each material's unpainted look, used only by the 'unpainted' preview. colourable is unknown until the in-game dump says which tilesets have a TilesetMaterialInfo.Colorable material.
